raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00), so raw_transactions has 349 txn_ids with exact duplicate copies that differ only in ingest_ts. The silver step does not dedupe, so the gold tables are double-counted. Deduplicating on txn_id in silver_transactions is safe because the copies are identical in every other column.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1;"}}
